description: This Kotlin source file defines the TradeRepository class, which manages trade data operations such as retrieval, insertion, update, deletion, analytics summarization, and CSV import/export for a trading application.

classes.name: TradeRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing trade data interactions with the local database and providing analytics and CSV import/export functionalities.

methods.name: getAllTrades
methods.description: Retrieves all trades from the local database.

methods.name: getTradeById
methods.description: Fetches a specific trade by its unique ID.

methods.name: insertTrade
methods.description: Inserts a new trade record into the database.

methods.name: deleteTrade
methods.description: Deletes a trade by its ID.

methods.name: getTradesByStatus
methods.description: Retrieves trades filtered by their status (e.g., 'OPEN', 'CLOSED').

methods.name: getTradesByDate
methods.description: Fetches trades that occurred on a specific date.

methods.name: getDistinctTradeDates
methods.description: Returns a list of unique trade dates for calendar views.

methods.name: getAnalyticsSummary
methods.description: Calculates and returns an analytics summary based on all closed trades, including metrics like total profit/loss, win rate, largest wins/losses, average holding days, and symbol performance.

methods.name: exportTradesToCsv
methods.description: Exports all trade data into a CSV formatted string.

methods.name: importTradesFromCsv
methods.description: Imports trade data from a CSV string, creating new trade records.

methods.name: parseCsvLine
methods.description: Helper method to parse a CSV line into individual fields, handling quoted strings.
